item.title: Park Bench and Bicycle Found in Copse, 18th August
item.description:
Location: East Wickham Open Space. Inside a copse of trees involved in a recent root fire on other side of circular footpath opposite the top of the Bournewood Road footpaths. Access via the side of the copse. What: You will encounter the following: 1) a hanging bicycle chain 2) a Voi bicycle (I will raise a separate report) 3) a park bench taken from nearby in 2024. This needs to be relocated into a more suitable location. The old location was always waterlogged!!! 4) You will see where the fire reached! I have done a public nextdoor report on this: https://nextdoor.co.uk/p/YmpwwwNMWBXp
